title: A zero integral matrix fiber has a zero open neighborhood
statement: Under the locally free rational-cokernel hypothesis for a finite-free integral matrix, there is a pro-etale cover such that, whenever all canonical coefficients vanish at a point of a member, some open neighborhood has zero normalized pullback morphism. Coordinates and pullback are the explicit constructions of [def-weil-pbc-integral-matrix-analytic-data].

source.place: Section 6.8, Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1): integral coefficient framework and kernel-closure application; the displayed continuous-function pivot argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument written out in Lemma 6.8.7

proof.text: Choose the constant pointwise rank cover. A zero coefficient matrix at a point forces rank zero everywhere on that member. A matrix of rank zero is the zero matrix.
Take the whole member as an open neighborhood. Compatibility under further pullback makes all coefficients of its composite pullback zero.

Conjugate each regular entry to the continuous regular module. Its coefficient determines it, so every entry is zero. Biproduct extensionality and the faithful coefficient equivalence make the original normalized pullback morphism zero.

proof_origin.place: Section 6.8, continuous coefficient framework; analytic matrix-chart reduction
proof_origin.note: The matrix argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument stated in Lemma 6.8.7.

lean.statement:
theorem integralMatrix_zero_neighborhood (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (n t : ℕ) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) n ⟶
      Mod.finiteFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) t)
    (hC : ∃ V : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ k,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (V.f k)).mapMod _).obj
          ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
            (cokernel a)))) :
    ∃ V : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ k (x : V.X k),
      (∀ i j, integralMatrixPullbackFunctions ℓ E (V.f k) a i j x = 0) →
        ∃ U : (V.X k).Opens, x ∈ U ∧
          (integralMatrixPullback ℓ E (U.ι ≫ V.f k)).map a = 0
